title: EasyFAB local user preferences v1
description: Presentation only. Ownership must match the validated active workspace and authenticated EasyFAB session; these fields never establish identity or authorization. No shared data, paths or credentials.

theme.description: Light preserves the current UI. System follows OS appearance only, never OS identity. Rendering all variants is required before exposing the control.

ui_scale.description: Standard preserves current UI density; large increases text and controls. No reduction of accessible targets.
